title: Numbers 19:8-9 — burner is unclean until evening; ashes kept as water of purification
summary: Numbers 19:8 in English and Hebrew (the one who burns the heifer washes his clothes and bathes in water and is unclean until evening), plus Numbers 19:9 in English (a clean man gathers the ashes outside the camp, kept as water to remove impurity, purification from sin). Water, unclean, clean, ashes and heifer are colour-coded.

text.text: 8 ‘The one who burns it shall also wash his clothes in water and bathe his body in water and shall be unclean until evening.
8 והשרף אתה יכבס בגדיו במים ורחץ בשרו במים וטמא עד־הערב׃

9 ‘Now a man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer and deposit them outside the camp in a clean place, and the congregation of the sons of Israel shall keep it as water to remove impurity; it is purification from sin.

refs.shown: Numbers 19:9 (verse text below the reference header)

uncertain: In the English of verse 9, the letters 'el' of Israel are coloured (blue and gold); not explained on the slide.
